title: Smiling Mother & Toddler in Outdoor Pool, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black-and-white snapshot capturing a smiling mother supporting her young toddler in the shimmering water of an outdoor swimming pool. A poolside deck and wooden bench or table with a towel are visible in the background against a grassy fence line, evoking quintessential post-war American suburban leisure and family summer activities.
